sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Snootli Creek Park
100 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 5-8 contained within the following described boundaries: That portion of the Southwest Quarter of Section 3, Township 2, Range 3, Coast District, northwest of Snootli Creek flowing in a general northeasterly direction through Section 3, Township 2. [en. B.C. Reg. 46/89, s. 7.]
